purpose: One-shot doc-reviewer on the records docspec in CLAUDE.md rule 2 and records/README.md

seats.name: doc-reviewer

outcome: Four defects: record style defined only by exemplar; 'the library' undefined; two sourcing requirements unreconciled; a soft line cap. All fixed before the writer drafted.
lessons: run the doc-reviewer on any docspec before a team drafts against it
